designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1972 through the purchase of land along the Hanalei River to protect endangered Hawaiian waterbirds.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Hanalei National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
FWS ServCat: Inventory and Monitoring Plan for Kauai NWR Complex: Hanalei NWR established in 1972

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Hanalei National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1972, is the oldest and largest (917 acres) of the three wildlife refuges that make up the Kauai National Wildlife Refuge Complex.
